_om: Sladrehanken in English (Blabbermouth, rusj.no/en/blabbermouth/) – Never have I ever. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The cards are in data.en/kort.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
A card you made up yourselves.
Noe du tror noen her har gjort?: Something you think someone here has done?
Alene om det – og tom for liv!: The only one – and out of lives!
A good story will save you.
Kortversjonen holder, og en god historie: The short version will do, and a good story wins the life back.
Hvert kort begynner med «Jeg har aldri …: Every card starts with ‘Never have I ever …’. If you have done it, you’re caught out – and the story is welcome.
Den som har mobilen, leser hele kortet:: Whoever has the phone reads the whole card: ‘Never have I ever …’ Then the phone goes on to the next person.
Trykk på knappen. På «AVSLØR!» rekker al: Press the button. On ‘HANDS UP!’ everyone who HAS done it puts a hand up – all at once.
Trykk på alle som rakte opp hånda. De mi: Tap everyone who put a hand up. They lose a life. When the first player runs out, the game is over – and whoever has the most lives left is the most innocent.
Er du alene om det, må historien fram. E: If you’re the only one, out comes the story. If it’s a good one, the crew gives you the life back.
Nobody has to tell more than they want to. You’re allowed to pass.
Av og til finner dere på resten av setni: Now and then you make up the rest of the sentence yourselves. Feel free to aim at someone round the table!
Vil dere spille til bare én står igjen?: Want to play until only one is left? Choose it under ‘The game lasts until …’.
Velg «Bare kort» hvis dere vil lese og p: Choose ‘Just cards’ if you’d rather read and chat without counting lives.
Festpakken er for voksne og er ikke med: The Party pack is for adults and stays out until you choose it.
Har du gjort det, er du avslørt!: If you’ve done it, you’re caught out!
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Mist et liv hver gang du er avslørt. Fle: Lose a life every time you’re caught out. Most lives at the end wins.
Read, laugh and swipe on. No points.
Ingen blir sittende og se på: Når den fø: Nobody sits and watches: when the first player runs out of lives, it’s time for the results.
Den som går tom for liv, er ute. Den sis: Run out of lives and you’re out. The last one with lives left wins.
Har du gjort det? Rekk opp hånda!: Have you done it? Hands up!
Har du gjort det? Rekk opp hånda på «AVS: Have you done it? Put your hand up on ‘HANDS UP!’
Tap everyone who put a hand up.
Tomme for liv – samtidig: Out of lives – at the same time
{navn} ran out of lives on the same card.
Tomt for liv på samme kort. Det er mye å: Out of lives on the same card. That’s a lot of stories!
Har gjort {n} av {alle} ting. Det er mye: Has done {n} of {alle} things. That’s a lot of stories!
Først ute – de har levd et spennende liv: First out – they’ve lived exciting lives.
First out – has lived an exciting life.
Dermed er spillet over. Hvem er uskyldig: So the game is over. Who’s the most innocent?
Like mange liv igjen. Like uskyldige – e: The same number of lives left. Equally innocent – or equally good liars?
Not caught out once in {n} cards. An angel – or just a good liar?
Avslørt bare {ganger} på {n} kort. Miste: Caught out only {ganger} in {n} cards. Suspiciously innocent!
Først ute. Her er det mange historier å: First out. There are plenty of stories here!
Avslørt flest ganger. Her er det mange h: Caught out the most. There are plenty of stories here!
Won a life back with a good story.
Fikk livet tilbake for {n} gode historie: Won lives back with {n} good stories.
Kortet som avslørte flest: The card that caught out the most
Hvem har gjort det? Trykk på alle som ra: Who’s done it? Tap everyone who put a hand up.
Alle ville røket ut samtidig – kortet te: Everyone would be out at once – this card doesn’t count!
{navn} is the only one and lost a life. Tell us! A good story wins the life back.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You’ll go straight to the results. Whoever has the most lives left is the most innocent.
You can always start a new one.
Kortet som avslørte flest, fant vi på se: The card that caught out the most was one we made up ourselves.
The card that caught out the most: ‘{kort}’.
